title: Crosswind Docking Practice Log
dataSources: NMEA/SignalK data (`nmea:reading`), bilge pump (`bilge:event`), mooring/anchor watch (`mooring:status`), marine weather (`marineweather:forecast`).
app: Marine electronics — NMEA 2000 / SignalK boat networks, bilge, battery and shore-power sensors, anchor-watch GPS, and marine weather feeds — streamed to Splunk HEC via SignalK and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nmea:reading maneuver=docking
| stats avg(crosswind_kts) as avg_crosswind, avg(docking_score) as avg_score, count as attempts by marina
| sort - avg_crosswind
description: Shows how much crosswind docking practice you are getting and how it is going.
value: Docking skill improves faster when you can see the conditions you have actually practiced in rather than remembering only the awkward ones.
implementation: Tag docking maneuvers in NMEA-derived sessions; compare attempt count, crosswind, and score by marina.
visualization: Marina table of docking attempts, average crosswind, and docking score.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how much crosswind docking practice you are really getting, not just the handful of memorable hard approaches.
